text:
Sarah S.: FYI — AcmeHealth POC moving to final sign. Finance asked for PO and clarified pricing cadence. The MSA/DPA have 2 procurement redlines. Attaching order form: https://files.redwood/incoming/ord_12345.pdf
Mike L.: Saw the redlines. Biggest gaps are the KMS key control language and the SLA uptime metric. Legal can accept a limited CMK/HSM model but needs responsibilities spelled out. Can you paste the exact redline snippets?
Nina P.: Pasted from Acme procurement below: ```
5.2 KMS: Customer requests "Customer-managed HSM required" for all keys used to encrypt customer data at rest.
SLA: Customer requests 99.99% monthly uptime and financial credits for violations.
```
Tom SE: From an infra POV we can support customer-managed keys for Private deployments / VPC but it requires a different ops runbook and adds cost. Ballpark +10% to monthly committed price and a 4–6 week onboarding window.
Sarah S.: Finance prefers Net30 (customer policy). Are we ok to accept Net30 vs Net45? Also need final SKU/quantity lines so procurement can issue PO.
Mike L.: Legal is fine with Net30. On KMS we can offer a compromise: Customer-managed keys supported as an addendum (appendix) with responsibility matrix. For the SLA we can offer 99.5% for POC and a commercial SLA for Dedicated. I'll draft a one-page amendment clarifying both and include fallback credits formula.
Nina P.: Procurement contact is jessica@acmehealth.com. Their PO flow: they will issue PO after they receive the signed orderform and the amendment. Jessica wants the orderform to include invoice schedule and billing contact.
Sarah S.: Can we route e-sign as: Legal -> Sales -> Customer? We want to avoid double countersign unless customer insists. Also, can we attach the amendment to the same DocuSign envelope?
Mike L.: Route: Legal signs internally, Sales triggers DocuSign to customer. If amendment is minor we can include it in the same envelope as an addendum; if heavy redlines we send separately. Using template `msa-amend-v2` is preferred.
Tom SE: Note to Sales/Legal: POC perf targets to include in orderform: p50 latency ~120ms, p95 ~350ms, token pricing as discussed. Also flag that quantization/CPU optimizations could slightly change per-token cost; include a note under billing: "unit price subject to model/quantization adjustments with 30-day notice."
Sarah S.: I'll assemble the orderform with SKUs, quantities, and Net30 payment term and ping you both. Please confirm if the +10% CMK surcharge needs a new SKU or a line item.
Mike L.: Put it as line item: "CMK support (one-time onboarding fee)" + "CMK monthly management surcharge". I'll attach the amendment and route for signature by EOD. :thumbsup:
Nina P.: I'll follow up with Jessica to confirm PO timing once the signed docs are out. Thanks team.
Sarah S.: Perfect — thanks. Will update the thread after I upload the orderform draft.
